description: Small project-labelled development corpus. Not independently annotated or representative of all jobs. Original sentences and families stay in one split; source paraphrases and user examples are test-only.
label_policy: Expected labels describe supported duties within the 24-capability vocabulary. Acceptable labels are defensible alternatives. Empty expected lists permit abstention. Titles and workplace complaints do not establish unstated skills. Out-of-vocabulary tasks are not exhaustively labelled.
